needle.en: How many research or discussion items did the 2021 literature review of the moral consideration of artificial entities identify, and what did it conclude about the empirical side of the field?
A 2021 paper in the Cambridge Quarterly of Healthcare Ethics asks how we could know whether a robot was a moral patient. Which five criteria does it survey, and which one does it end up defending?

needle.sv: En artikel i Perspectives in Biology and Medicine från 2022 granskar kriterier för robotars moraliska status. Vilken typ av redogörelse försvarar författaren, och vilket problem tas upp därefter?

needle.en: What argument does the paper "Moral Status for Malware!" make against granting moral status to AI that passes consciousness-related criteria?
A 2024 paper in Neuroscience of Consciousness presents a "no-go theorem" for consciousness on a chip. Is it a proof that AI on current hardware cannot be conscious?

needle.sv: I sitt svar på kritiken mot "the unfolding argument" hävdar författarna att integrerad informationsteori (IIT) hamnar i en särskild position. Vad kallar de den, och vilket argument ger de mot att förstapersonsupplevelse skulle kunna rädda teorin?

needle.en: A 1999 Behavioral and Brain Sciences paper applied a symmetry analysis of colour space to Locke's inverted spectrum argument. What did it find about the literal version of that argument, and what did it call the general limit it derived?

needle.sv: Vad är huvudargumentet i "Illusionism Big and Small" (eNeuro, 2024) för att någon form av illusionism behövs i varje fungerande teori om medvetande?

needle.en: The 2007 Science paper "Dimensions of mind perception" reported a factor analysis of how people judge the mental capacities of human and nonhuman characters. Which two dimensions emerged, what example capacity is given for each, and what did they predict?

"Feeling robots and human zombies" (Cognition, 2012) proposes a mind-perception explanation of the uncanny valley. Which of the two mind-perception dimensions does it hold responsible, and what did its third experiment extend the account to?

needle.sv: Vilka tre psykologiska faktorer förklarar enligt trefaktorteorin om antropomorfism (Psychological Review, 2007) när människor tillskriver icke-mänskliga aktörer mänskliga egenskaper?

needle.en: A 2008 Psychological Science paper linked loneliness to anthropomorphism. What did its three studies find, and what alternative explanation did the third study rule out?
"The harm-made mind" (Psychological Science, 2013) is sometimes cited as evidence that robots have minds. What does the study actually establish?

A 2020 Cognitive Science paper pitted moral typecasting theory against the dehumanization literature using harmful and benevolent robotic agents. Which account did the results support, and what happened to the perceived suffering of a human victim?
What did the 2020 Science study of crows performing a visual detection task report, and why was it taken as bearing on whether a cerebral cortex is needed for sensory consciousness?

needle.sv: Vilka fem dimensioner föreslår ramverket i "Dimensions of Animal Consciousness" (Trends in Cognitive Sciences, 2020), och vad följer av ramverket för frågan om vissa djur är "mer medvetna" än andra?

needle.en: On what structural analogy do Klein and Barron base their 2016 PNAS argument about insects, and exactly how strong is the claim they make?

The 2026 updated assessment of sentience in cephalopod molluscs scores four groups against a set of criteria. How many criteria are there, how did octopuses, cuttlefish, squid and nautiluses score, and what does the paper say every failure to satisfy a criterion was due to?
What does the 2019 review of nociception and pain in fish models present as the evidence that fish experience pain, and how does it describe the relation to mammals?

needle.sv: Vad visade experimentet med humlor och uppvärmda matstationer (PNAS, 2022), och hur formulerade författarna sin slutsats?

needle.en: Honey bees were shown to opt out of difficult visual discriminations. What was the finding, and how cautious were the authors about calling it metacognition?

A 2020 review in Neuroscience and Biobehavioral Reviews sets out a programme for a comparative science of emotion. What is the specific methodological problem it identifies, and how does it propose to attack it?

needle.sv: Franklin och Graesser byggde 1999 en programvaruagent som skulle förverkliga Baars teori om ett globalt arbetsutrymme. Vad hette agenten, och vad gjorde den?

needle.en: According to the LIDA timing model of the cognitive cycle proposed by Madl, Baars and Franklin, how long does one cognitive cycle take, and how is it broken down?

Aleksander and Morton's 2008 chapter on computational studies of consciousness breaks consciousness into five axioms and introduces an abstract architecture. Name the five axioms and the architecture.

needle.sv: Aleksanders översiktskapitel om maskinmedvetande från 2005 delar in fältet i två ändar av ett spektrum. Vad skiljer ändarna åt, och vad kallas den ena av dem?

needle.en: Shanahan's 2006 cognitive architecture combines a global workspace with something else, and was given a concrete implementation. What is the second ingredient, and what was the implementation built from?
In Chella, Frixione and Gaglio's cognitive architecture for robot self-consciousness, how many computational areas does the architecture have, and what construct models higher-order perception?
Clowes and Seth distinguish 'strong' and 'weak' synthetic methods in consciousness science. Which one do they argue artificial consciousness should be pursued as, and why?

needle.sv: Wilterson och Graziano tränade ett djupt Q-nätverk att styra en uppmärksamhetsstrålkastare i en fångstuppgift. Vad hände när uppmärksamhetsschemat stängdes av, och när det togs bort redan före inlärningen?

Pennartz, Farisco och Evers föreslår 2019 indikatorer i stället för en tröskel för medvetande hos djur och intelligenta maskiner. Hur många indikatorer är det, vilka är de, och vad säger artikeln om dagens maskiner?

needle.en: In their 1995 Nature paper, what did Crick and Koch argue about primary visual cortex (V1) and visual awareness, and what evidence did they base it on?

Leopold and Logothetis rapidly swapped the two rival images between the eyes in their 1996 Nature study 'What is rivalling during binocular rivalry?'. What happened to perception, and what did that rule out?
In Dehaene and colleagues' 2001 fMRI study of masked words, which cortical areas did unseen masked words activate, and where did the activation disappear?
In Sergent, Baillet and Dehaene's 2005 attentional-blink study, which early ERP components were preserved for unseen words, and at what latency did seen and unseen words diverge?

The P3 and induced gamma-band activity were long treated as signatures of visual awareness. What did Pitts and colleagues find in 2014 when they manipulated awareness and task relevance independently?
Why did consciousness researchers start building no-report paradigms, according to Tsuchiya and colleagues' 2015 review?

Frässle and colleagues used optokinetic nystagmus and pupil size to track binocular rivalry without asking for reports. What changed in the frontal cortex between the active-report and passive conditions?

needle.sv: Man hör ofta att hjärnan stänger av när man somnar. Vad hittade Massimini och kollegor 2005 när de sköt in en TMS-puls i premotoriska barken under djupsömn och mätte svaret med tät-EEG?

needle.en: Ferrarelli and colleagues extended the sleep TMS-EEG finding to a drug in 2010. Which drug, how long did the awake responses last, and what measure discriminated the two states?
How is the perturbational complexity index (PCI) computed in Casali et al. 2013, and which states was it tested across?

needle.sv: Är gränsvärdet för perturbationskomplexitetsindex (PCI) en universell mätare av medvetande? Vad gjorde Casarotto och kollegor 2016?

needle.en: What problem with the original PCI did PCIst solve in 2019, on how many subjects was it validated, and what did the intracranial test show?

needle.sv: Vad visade Owen och kollegor i Science 2006 hos en patient som uppfyllde kriterierna för vegetativt tillstånd?

needle.en: Monti and colleagues scaled the tennis-imagery paradigm to a cohort in the NEJM in 2010. How many patients were studied, how many could wilfully modulate their brain activity, and how many communicated?
Cruse and colleagues moved covert command-following from fMRI to bedside EEG in 2011. How many of their vegetative-state patients responded, and how accurate was the classification?
In Claassen et al. 2019, how often was brain activation to spoken motor commands detected in acutely unresponsive ICU patients, and how did those patients fare at 12 months?

What proportion of participants without an observable response to commands showed cognitive motor dissociation in the 2024 NEJM multicentre cohort, and what was the comparable rate among participants who did respond behaviourally?
Why did Claassen's group test aphasia in patients who could already follow commands, and what did the study quantify?

needle.sv: Hur ofta blev diagnosen vegetativt tillstånd fel när Schnakers och kollegor 2009 jämförde läkarnas konsensusbedömning med den standardiserade skalan CRS-R?

needle.en: In the 2014 Lancet clinical validation study, how did FDG-PET and active fMRI compare for identifying minimally conscious patients?
The B-Aware trial is the one BIS study that did show a benefit. What was its effect size, and how large was the trial?
What did the isolated forearm technique reveal about connected consciousness after tracheal intubation in the 2017 multicentre study, and did those patients remember anything?
What incidence of connected consciousness after intubation was found in 18-to-40-year-olds, and how did it differ by sex?

needle.sv: Varför skiljer sig ketamin från propofol och xenon när man mäter komplexiteten i barkens TMS-svar, och vad rapporterade försökspersonerna efteråt?

needle.en: The spectral exponent of resting EEG was tested against the same three anaesthetics as the TMS complexity work. How many participants per drug, and how did ketamine behave?
Which three simultaneous EEG changes marked loss of consciousness during gradual propofol induction in Purdon et al. 2013?
Schartner and colleagues measured MEG signal diversity under psilocybin, ketamine and LSD. How did the values compare with normal waking rest, and which measure showed it most strongly?

needle.sv: Vad hittade Siclari och kollegor 2017 när de jämförde uppvaknanden då försökspersoner mindes drömmar med uppvaknanden då de inte mindes något?

needle.en: In Voss et al. 2009, which frequency band separated lucid dreaming from ordinary REM sleep, and where on the scalp was it strongest?
Two-way communication with a dreaming person was demonstrated in 2021. How many participants were tested, how many questions were answered correctly, and how many individuals produced those answers?
Kouider et al. looked for the adult signature of conscious access in infants. How many infants, which ages, and how did the latency of the marker change with age?

needle.sv: Vad talar för att en kråka kan ha sinnesmedvetande, trots att fågelhjärnan saknar en skiktad hjärnbark?

needle.en: What is the structural argument Barron and Klein make for subjective experience in insects, and how far back does it push the origin of consciousness?

Contrastive analysis - comparing trials where a content is consciously perceived against trials where it is not - is the standard method for isolating an NCC. What did Aru and colleagues argue it actually delivers?

The 2025 adversarial collaboration between integrated information theory and global neuronal workspace theory reported results from how many participants and which methods, and what did it find against each theory?

What did Pinto and colleagues find when they tested split-brain patients with confirmed complete callosotomy across the whole visual field, and how did they establish that the responses were conscious?
What is blindsight, and what is the main methodological worry Cowey raises about the evidence for it?

In the 2004 BMC Neuroscience paper that launched integrated information theory, which two phenomenological properties of consciousness motivate the claim that consciousness is the capacity to integrate information, and how is Phi defined?
What is "qualia space (Q)" in Tononi's 2008 provisional manifesto, and how does a particular experience correspond to it?

needle.sv: Vilka tre grundsatser (axiom) räknar den uppdaterade beskrivningen av integrerad informationsteori från 2012 upp, och vad säger uteslutningspostulatet?

needle.en: What identity does IIT 3.0 (Oizumi, Albantakis and Tononi, 2014) assert between experience and physical structure, and what does it imply about functionally equivalent feed-forward systems?

In Baars's 2002 retrospective on global workspace theory, which three reasons does he give for the theory having had little impact when the evidence for the conscious access hypothesis was first described about two decades earlier?

needle.sv: Vilka tre iakttagelser menar Dehaene och Naccache (2001) att varje teori om medvetande måste kunna rymma?

needle.en: In Sergent, Baillet and Dehaene's 2005 attentional-blink study, which early evoked potentials were intact for unseen words, and at what latency did the seen and unseen conditions diverge?
Dehaene and Changeux's 2011 Neuron review names three objective neural measures of conscious access. What are they?
Where does Baars's 2005 chapter say the global workspace or "blackboard" architecture came from, and what imaging contrast does he cite as supporting it?
Which two major criticisms of higher-order theories do Lau and Rosenthal explicitly defend against in their 2011 review of the empirical evidence?
In LeDoux and Brown's 2017 higher-order theory of emotional consciousness, what role do subcortical circuits play in conscious feelings?
What is the central analogy of attention schema theory as Graziano and Webb state it in 2015, and what testable prediction do they draw from it?
Graziano's 2020 reply article sets out attention schema theory as a chain of four distinct things. What are they?
What does Graziano's 2022 PNAS framework add to attention schema theory beyond the mechanistic account, and what evidential claim does it make?

needle.sv: Vad säger Lamme och Roelfsema (2000) om den framåtriktade vågen i synsystemet jämfört med återkopplande bearbetning?
Vilka två teorier riktar sig "uppvecklingsargumentet" (the unfolding argument) från 2019 mot, vilket gemensamt antagande angriper det, och vad blir slutsatsen?

needle.en: What is the "dissociative epiphenomenalism" charge that Herzog, Schurger and Doerig level at IIT in 2022, and why do they call it self-undermining?
What did Doerig, Schurger and Herzog actually do in the 2021 "Hard criteria for empirical theories of consciousness" paper, and what problem motivated it?

needle.sv: Den motsatsställda samarbetsstudien som publicerades i Nature 2025 beskrivs ofta som att den avgjorde striden mellan integrerad informationsteori och global neuronal arbetsyta. Vad kom den faktiskt fram till?

needle.en: What did the 2023 PLOS ONE adversarial collaboration protocol preregister before any data were collected, and how many laboratories were to run it?
The adversarial collaboration was extended to animals in a 2026 protocol. Which species, which recording method, and which causal manipulations are specified?
According to Friston's 2010 review, which single quantity keeps emerging as the thing being optimized when different global brain theories are read through the free-energy lens?

needle.sv: Vad innebär "interoceptiv prediktiv kodning" i den modell som Seth och Critchley föreslog 2013?

needle.en: Seth and Hohwy (2021) argue for theories "for" consciousness science rather than theories "of" consciousness. What is the distinction and what motivates it?
Which four theoretical approaches does the 2022 Nature Reviews Neuroscience review by Seth and Bayne cover, and what does it say about whether they can be told apart?
Is there a peer-reviewed paper in the indexed literature that establishes integrated information theory as pseudoscience?
